text: N=64 seed-23 force (m2 fixed, data_seed 1) ends at about 0.845 at layer 1 under both the 12000-step and 24000-step schedules, while N=128 seed 23 is still gaining about 0.008 per doubling of horizon. If N=128 seed 23 is trained to 48000 steps, does it come within 0.02 of 0.845, so that every small-gap seed counts as slow convergence rather than a ceiling?
